name: verify-selection-tracking
description: Model-check what Claude sees as the user's current selection in claudecode.nvim (TLA+/TLC) against guards read from the current Lua code, and replay paths on headless Neovim. Use after a change to selection tracking (lua/claudecode/selection.lua, its enable/disable calls in lua/claudecode/init.lua, server.broadcast or on_connect in lua/claudecode/server/init.lua, or the getCurrentSelection and getLatestSelection tools), to the debounce or demotion timers, the visual-exit flush, or held-selection
author: coder
